import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 2345678;
    static double[] input_probs = new double[123];
    static double[] probs_array = new double[123];
    static double[] dp_vals = new double[MAX_LIMIT];
    static double[] output = new double[123];
    static int[] index_map = new int[123];
    static int[] count_bits = new int[MAX_LIMIT];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_input = sc.nextInt();
        int max_k_value = sc.nextInt();

        int valid_count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            input_probs[i] = sc.nextDouble();
            if (input_probs[i] > 1e-4) {
                index_map[valid_count] = i;
                probs_array[valid_count] = input_probs[i];
                valid_count++;
            }
        }

        max_k_value = Math.min(max_k_value, valid_count);

        count_bits[0] = 0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << valid_count); mask++) {
            count_bits[mask] = count_bits[mask & (mask - 1)] + 1;
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << valid_count); mask++) {
            dp_vals[mask] = 0.0;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            output[i] = 0.0;
        }

        dp_vals[0] = 1.0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << valid_count); mask++) {
            if (count_bits[mask] == max_k_value) {
                for (int j = 0; j < valid_count; j++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        output[index_map[j]] += dp_vals[mask];
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            double total_prob_sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < valid_count; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) continue;
                total_prob_sum += probs_array[j];
            }
            double ratio = dp_vals[mask] / total_prob_sum;
            for (int j = 0; j < valid_count; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) continue;
                int next_mask = mask | (1 << j);
                dp_vals[next_mask] += probs_array[j] * ratio;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < total_input; i++) {
            if (i > 0) System.out.print(" ");
            System.out.printf("%.17f", output[i]);
        }
        System.out.println();
        sc.close();
    }
}
